name: Ssam Ssam
about: Nestled in the heart of a vibrant city, our family-run Korean restaurant located in Wimbledon stands as a culinary oasis, with a long-standing Korean culinary background in London since the early 2000s.

With a heritage spanning generations, we have mastered the art of Korean cuisine, infusing it with the warmth and authenticity only a family touch can provide. Our menu is a carefully curated journey through the diverse flavours of Korea, featuring a symphony of ingredients sourced from the finest purveyors.
menuTagline: Every dish is crafted with care, sourcing the finest ingredients to bring the comfort of Korean home cooking into a refined London setting.
